1	# Design
     2	
     3	## Architecture
     4	
     5	The 3-layer principle (packages → verticals → apps) is unchanged; only member
     6	count changes. Every merge is a history-preserving `git mv` of a `src/` tree into
     7	a submodule of the surviving member, plus a dependency-union rewrite of the
     8	surviving member's pyproject. Zero cross-package imports exist today (grep sweep
     9	2026-06-11), so no import-rewrite pass is needed beyond the moved packages' own
    10	`__init__` files.
    11	
    12	```
    13	BEFORE (17)                          AFTER (8)
    14	-----------                          ---------
    15	packages/                            packages/
    16	  hdp-canonical  --+                   hdp-core        <- canonical, audit,
    17	  hdp-audit      --+                                      identity, consent,
    18	  hdp-identity   --+--- merge ----->                      provenance, outbox
    19	  hdp-consent    --+                                      (submodules)
    20	  hdp-provenance --+                   hdp-api         <- + ingest (submodule)
    21	  hdp-outbox     --+                   hdp-agent       (unchanged)
    22	  hdp-ingest     ------ merge ----->   hdp-observability (unchanged, real code)
    23	  hdp-api                              hdp-hitl        <- hh-hitl promoted
    24	  hdp-agent                                               (schema-seed FR-102)
    25	  hdp-observability                  verticals/home-health/
    26	verticals/home-health/                 hh-scribe       <- + oasis, skills, mcp
    27	  hh-oasis       --+                                      (submodules)
    28	  hh-skills      --+--- merge ----->   hh-emr-sync     (standalone: seam boundary)
    29	  hh-mcp         --+                 apps/
    30	  hh-scribe                            home-health-scribe (deps remapped)
    31	  hh-hitl        ------ promote -->
    32	  hh-emr-sync
    33	apps/
    34	  home-health-scribe
    35	```
    36	
    37	Dependency edges after the trim (union rule, NFR-002):
    38	
    39	- `hdp-core` ← pydantic, fhir.resources, sqlmodel
    40	- `hdp-api` ← fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic
    41	- `hdp-hitl` ← fastapi, hdp-core
    42	- `hh-scribe` ← anthropic, pydantic, mcp, hdp-core, hdp-agent, hdp-api
    43	- `hh-emr-sync` ← httpx, hdp-core
    44	- `home-health-scribe` ← fastapi, uvicorn, hh-scribe, hdp-hitl, hh-emr-sync
    45	
    46	## File manifest
    47	
    48	Single SoT is `tasks.yaml` `manifest:` (file -> new|modified -> purpose). For the
    49	seam contract, target-map model, golden example, and AC-mapped test manifest see
    50	`reference/`.
    51	
    52	## Decisions
    53	
    54	- **`hh-emr-sync` stays a standalone member** — its adapter seam is the
    55	  integration point for the computer-use transport (#14/#18); a separate member
    56	  keeps the dependency surface auditable (today exactly httpx + one workspace
    57	  dep). The `EmrSyncTransport` Protocol stub (`reference/emr_sync_transport.py`,
    58	  landed as `hh_emr_sync.transport`) is the only interface code this spec adds —
    59	  it makes seam preservation verifiable (AC-005) rather than aspirational.
    60	- **`hdp-outbox` merges into `hdp-core`, not `hh-emr-sync`** — the outbox is a
    61	  data-layer persistence pattern (sqlmodel dep, same as audit/consent); the
    62	  vertical consumes it, doesn't own it.
    63	- **`hh-mcp` merges into `hh-scribe`, not `hdp-api`** — the MCP server exposes
    64	  home-health workflow tools; it is vertical-specific serving surface, not a
    65	  platform primitive.
    66	- **`hdp-hitl` promotion honors hdp-schema-seed FR-102 verbatim** — the
    67	  alternative (folding HITL into `hdp-core`) would force edits to an approved,
    68	  partially-executed spec; placement cost is one extra member, well inside the
    69	  ≤8 budget.
    70	- **Trust-boundary NFR deleted** — the trim adds no input-accepting surface; the
    71	  only "inputs" are workspace files whose malformed states `uv`/`pytest` already
    72	  fail fast on. Keeping a vacuous NFR would force a vacuous AC.
    73	- **Commitlint sequencing** — the scope-enum change lands in its own config phase
    74	  *after* the structural phase; trim commits use surviving scopes (`packages`,
    75	  `verticals`, `workspace`) so no commit references a scope being deleted by the
    76	  same PR.
    77	- **No ADR lift** — placement choices above are spec-scoped consequences of the
    78	  existing 3-layer architecture; the layer principle itself (the ADR-worthy
    79	  decision) is untouched.

# package-trim

## Summary

Collapse the uv workspace from 17 members to 8 (GH #11): merge six empty
data-layer shells into `hdp-core`, fold `hdp-ingest` into `hdp-api`, promote
`hh-hitl` to `packages/hdp-hitl` (satisfying hdp-schema-seed FR-102 so #12

history-preserving `git mv`; layering (packages → verticals → apps) is unchanged;
commitlint scopes, README, and CLAUDE.md follow the new map. The workspace is 226
src LOC with zero cross-package imports, so the rewrite is mechanical — the value
is honest structure (truthful Depth markers, member count matching code volume)
before #12 lands real code.

- Merged-module collisions avoided by submodule layout (`hdp_core.audit`, …) —

  (NFR-004; AC-010 verifies).
- `uv.lock` staleness across member removal: verify phase regenerates the lock;
  unknown whether `uv lock` needs `--upgrade` after member deletion — resolved at
  structural-phase run.
- `hdp-hitl` carries `fastapi` as a platform package — accepted now (HITL review
  API is platform-level per hdp-schema-seed design); revisit if API surfaces
  consolidate.
